summary:
## Standing operator rules
- “We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.”
- “All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact operation name sms:delivery_attempt in the metrics label.”
- “Run these steps in order, one at a time” for `rename_get_user_record`.
- “I'm stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.”
- “Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so the email scheduler does not send reminders to customers who already paid. The paused router split remains paused, not superseded. `rename_get_user_record` is temporarily paused in favor of this higher-priority bug.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Sandbox payments API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`.
- `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is shut down and returns stale fixtures; superseded, do not use.
- Twilio label: `sms:delivery_attempt`; maximum attempts: `2`.
- Tag: `rename-fetch-account-v1`.
- `get_user_record` → `fetch_account`; old name is superseded and must not remain at call sites.
- Rounding implementation: `billing/currency.py`.
- SQLAlchemy pool size 50 is the ruled-out approach; do not use.
- CLI currency field: `args.currency`; old `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Rename in `internal/users/repository.go`
- [done] Rename in `internal/accounts/service.go`
- [done] Rename in `internal/api/handlers.go`
- [done] Rename in `internal/billing/integration.go`
- [paused; next rename command] `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' internal/workers/user_job.go`
- [pending, individually and in order] Rename in `cmd/accountctl/command.go`, then `tests/integration/account_api_test.go`; verify no stale references; force-tag and push `rename-fetch-account-v1`.
- [pending, current bug] Inspect scheduler paid-state logic, add a regression test, implement the fix, and run focused tests.
- [status unknown] Earlier worker-test rerun after removing `_last_batch` had no observed result; a later full suite passed 118 tests, 7 skipped.

## Recent work
CLI billing filters were consolidated, duplicate currency options removed, abbreviation regression coverage added, and CLI/command tests passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Investigation then shifted to the dunning scheduler because it was incorrectly emailing already-paid customers.
